fusions.name: Silver Scatter
fusions.desc: Looses 4 silver motes at once in a spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 2 damage. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Upstream Dart
fusions.desc: You dart up to 6 tiles to the target and strike it for 13 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Scale Shimmer
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 30% of the elemental damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Slip the Net
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 4% more damage per stack (22% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
